ABOUT.HEADING: Why me
ABOUT.CONTENT: My journey into web development began during my training as a computer science teacher. Since then, I have been passionate about creating well-structured and functional applications. Using an analytical approach, I develop user-friendly solutions that excel both technically and visually.

SKILLS.HEADING: My Skills
SKILLS.FOCUS_TEXT: Whether deep backend logic or interactive frontend – I am constantly learning to implement innovative solutions with the right technologies.

PROJECTS.HEADING: Projects

ABOUT_TEXT.EL_POLLO_LOCO: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help Pepe defeat El Pollo Loco! Throw salsa bottles or jump on small chickens. Collect all the coins!
ABOUT_TEXT.POKEDEX: A dynamic web application that allows users to explore and search for Pokémon. It fetches and displays detailed data, such as stats, types, and images, directly from the PokéAPI in real-time.
ABOUT_TEXT.JOIN: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
ABOUT_TEXT.DABUBBLE: A modern business messenger (inspired by Slack) for efficient team communication. Create channels, start private chats, and exchange messages with your colleagues in real-time.
ABOUT_TEXT.ONGOING: I am currently expanding my expertise in Angular and learning to implement sophisticated architectures for larger applications. My goal is to develop features that are both technically brilliant and user-friendly.

PROJECTS.WORK_PROCESS: How I have organised my work process

WORK_PROCESS_TEXT.EL_POLLO_LOCO: Focused on modular class structures and inheritance. Ensured clean code via descriptive naming, JSDoc, and a strict logic-UI separation.
WORK_PROCESS_TEXT.POKEDEX: Learned how to efficiently fetch and process large amounts of JSON data using asynchronous JavaScript (Promises, async/await). Improved my dynamic UI design skills, particularly by implementing pagination features and responsive grid layouts.
WORK_PROCESS_TEXT.JOIN: I rely on modular components and a clear separation of logic and design. By using descriptive naming and clean documentation, the code remains easily maintainable and scalable for others.
WORK_PROCESS_TEXT.DABUBBLE: While developing the login area and several chat features, I placed particular emphasis on the highest security standards and an intuitive user experience. Thanks to a clear, modular structuring of the authentication logic and a clean separation of design and functionality, the code remains secure, performant, and easily extensible even as the number of users grows.

LEARN_TEXT.EL_POLLO_LOCO: Deepened my Vanilla JavaScript skills with a focus on Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). Mastered complex collision logic, game physics, and fluid animations without frameworks.
LEARN_TEXT.POKEDEX: Deepened my understanding of asynchronous API calls and learned how to implement a smooth search functionality across complex datasets. Furthermore, I expanded my dynamic DOM manipulation skills to create engaging, interactive detail views and modals on the fly.
LEARN_TEXT.JOIN: As part of a small development team, I programmed the core features. The close collaboration showed me how teamwork can efficiently overcome complex technical challenges.
LEARN_TEXT.DABUBBLE: Within the team, I took responsibility for the sensitive core areas, the complete authentication flow, as well as interactive features such as the emoji integration in the chat. In doing so, I learned how important precise state management is for user data and how, through close coordination within the development team, complex real-time features can be successfully and seamlessly integrated.

PRIVACY.HEADING: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: The following information explains how personal data is processed when you visit this website or contact me.
PRIVACY.CONTROLLER: The controller of this website is the person named in the imprint above. Address and contact details are provided on this page.
PRIVACY.HOSTING: This website is hosted by netcup GmbH, Emmy-Noether-Straße 10, 76131 Karlsruhe, Germany. When you visit the site, connection data such as your IP address, access time, requested content and browser information may be processed in server logs. This supports the secure operation of the website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Retention depends on the hosting and logging configuration.
PRIVACY.FORM: When you use the contact form, I process your name, email address and message to respond to your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR for pre-contractual enquiries and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR for other enquiries based on my legitimate interest in responding. The information is voluntary but required to process the enquiry through the form.
PRIVACY.MAIL: The form submits your information to a PHP script at julia-keller-dev.de; the message is then forwarded to my email inbox. The hosting and email providers may process data for delivery. As I use Gmail, processing by Google and transfers outside the European Economic Area cannot be ruled out.
PRIVACY.RETENTION: I keep enquiries and emails only as long as needed to respond and handle further correspondence, subject to legal retention duties. Server logs are kept according to the configured hosting retention periods.
PRIVACY.LANGUAGE: When you switch languages, the website stores your preference locally in your browser (localStorage) to remember it for future visits.
PRIVACY.LINKS: GitHub, LinkedIn and published projects are accessed through external links. The respective provider's data processing rules apply when you open those links.
PRIVACY.RIGHTS: Subject to the GDPR's conditions, you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it with future effect. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection authority. Please use the imprint contact details for enquiries.
